assessment.nobel_worthiness: A foundational synthesis for modern monetary policy analysis, connecting nominal rigidities, expectations and policy design.
assessment.attribution: Calvo, Taylor and Woodford represent distinct central building blocks, though the listed contribution was made by a broad intellectual community.
assessment.maturity: The framework has shaped central-bank models, policy analysis and macroeconomic research for decades.
uncertainties: Drawing a three-person boundary from the wider New Keynesian contribution is difficult.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Their work made political incentives, institutions and state capacity central to the analysis of fiscal policy and development.
assessment.attribution: Besley, Persson and Tabellini are leading, complementary contributors to the specified political-economy research program.
assessment.maturity: Theoretical and empirical influence is extensive and sustained across several decades.
uncertainties: The research program encompasses many contributors and several partially distinct mechanisms.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Firm heterogeneity and selection transformed trade theory and the measurement of trade-policy and globalization effects.
assessment.attribution: Melitz supplied the core heterogeneous-firm framework, with Helpman and Redding major contributors to its development and applications.
assessment.maturity: The contribution is deeply embedded in modern trade research and has generated a large empirical literature.
uncertainties: Credit for the broader heterogeneous-firm tradition extends beyond a small group.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dynamic-panel GMM supplied widely used tools for estimating causal and behavioral relationships when fixed effects and endogeneity are consequential.
assessment.attribution: Arellano and Bond developed the seminal estimator, while Blundell was central to the system-GMM extension.
assessment.maturity: The methods have had long-lived, field-spanning use and extensive methodological scrutiny.
uncertainties: Practical sensitivity to instrument choice and specification complicates assessment of applied reliability.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The misallocation framework gave a powerful quantitative account of how distorted input allocation can affect aggregate productivity and income gaps.
assessment.attribution: Hsieh and Klenow provided the prominent quantitative formulation, and Restuccia made foundational related contributions.
assessment.maturity: The approach has stimulated a substantial body of theory, measurement and policy-oriented research.
uncertainties: Inference from observed dispersion to distortions remains model-dependent.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Population administrative data revolutionized measurement of intergenerational mobility and made local opportunity a central policy and research question.
assessment.attribution: Chetty, Hendren and Friedman are closely identified with the core linked-data mobility program.
assessment.maturity: The findings and data methods have been highly influential and repeatedly extended.
uncertainties: The interpretation of place effects and transferability across institutional settings remains contested.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Heterogeneous-agent New Keynesian models materially changed analysis of distributional consequences and transmission channels of macroeconomic policy.
assessment.attribution: Moll, Violante and Kaplan are central architects of the modern quantitative framework.
assessment.maturity: The approach is now important in academic and policy macroeconomics, with substantial empirical and computational development.
uncertainties: Its relative youth and dependence on quantitative modeling choices leave the ultimate scope of the contribution less settled.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Their work extended economic analysis of exhaustible natural capital and welfare to environmental and biodiversity constraints.
assessment.attribution: Dasgupta and Heal are both central to the foundational economics of exhaustible resources and natural capital.
assessment.maturity: The contribution has endured and is increasingly salient in environmental accounting and policy analysis.
uncertainties: The valuation and aggregation of biodiversity and inclusive wealth retain major conceptual and empirical challenges.
